title: Why Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon remain cautious on long-awaited Williams upgrade package
paragraphs: On Thursday in Azerbaijan, Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon will finally be able to try the Williams FW48 upgrade package that has been in the pipeline since the start of the season. Aware that the car had some fundamental issues, the Grove team decided at an early stage to focus most of its R&D resources on one big hit, led by a revised and lighter chassis, along with a new aero package.
